title: Decisive Victory
ruleText: Receive 3 VP if all of your party members are alive at the end of the game.

title: Last Warning
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase; if your models do not declare Attack until your next Strategic Phase, you receive 3 VP.

title: Relentless Advance
ruleText: Reveal this Scheme during your Strategic Phase and discard it during the End Phase; receive 1 VP (to the max of 3) for every party member beyond the middle of the field at the end of this turn.
